verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an official CLI (`clai`) documented for chatting with LLMs from the terminal, launching a uvicorn web server, and can be launched directly from any Agent via `Agent.to_cli_sync()`. This is well documented in first-party docs and confirmed by a probe hit, though missing for 10: independent hands-on community confirmation specifically of the CLI tool itself (community comments focus on the framework, not `clai`).
